title: Settings save review cleanup
summary: Settings Save now previews through the backend before review, shows only backend-confirmed changed/removed keys, clears stale no-op candidates, and preserves strict confirmed save semantics.
reason: Operators were seeing unchanged submitted values in the Save review dialog, and a second Save after success could look like the same settings were changing again.
behavior_before: Save opened the review from locally submitted keys, so unchanged values could appear as review rows and stale staged JSON could remain after save.
behavior_after: Save first calls /api/settings/preview-patch, opens review only for backend-confirmed changes, skips /api/settings/save-patch on no-op preview, and clears staged JSON after no-op or successful save.
